message.reasoning_content:
We need to give bounded implementation advice: diagnose gap — historical CLI/HTTP mission status for a completed worker on a nonmanaged planned task that is blocked, no current review. Fixture currently returns mission-status-planning-unported. Actual scopes are waiting/ready.

Wait: scopes are waiting/ready — supported() already allows ready|waiting. The fixture returns mission-status-planning-unported... hmm. Where? Possibly planning.repository.is_some() && !agents.is_empty()? No—nonmanaged, no repository. Or task status blocked with completed agent but no matching review → planned_pair fails for blocked (requires matching_review). So supported() refuses with mission-status-planning-initial-tasks-unported or terminal-task-branch-unported. Task: blocked, agent completed, no review. planned_pair blocked branch: matches failed|interrupted or completed+matching_review. So completed without review → false → planning-unported? Actually the agents.iter().any(!planned_pair) → mission-status-planning-unported. That's the reported error.

Go behavior: result_presentation for blocked task with completed agent, no review: falls through review branches (currentReviewPresentation false), then t.Status=="submitted" false, then completed branch: provenReport → attribution → result_to_review or completed_unproven. So Go displays it. Rust supported() refuses because planned_pair requires matching_review for blocked+completed.

The Go blocked branch for completed agent without review: result goes to the completed branch (provenReport). Note Go also requires... Actually in Go, blocked+completed falls to completed branch. So minimal edit: allow planned_pair blocked+completed without matching review, and the terminal loop's blocked+completed case, and result_inputs_with_review already handles blocked+completed with review NotApplicable? Currently result_inputs_with_review refuses completed-unsubmitted unless blocked && Presented review. Hmm — Go for blocked without review falls through to the completed attribution branch. But Rust's completed-unsubmitted guard refuses. So need to permit blocked without review too, then supply attribution.

Also need real report attribution: provenReport equivalent — a read-only helper in mission_status_reports.rs mirroring relay's report() but without agent cwd (relay uses agent workspace; historical provenReport uses s.root for CLI? Go provenReport uses s.taskReports(task) on s.root; provenAttemptReport uses cwd — but task says don't reuse relay; status read-only uses root). Actually Go resultPresentation calls s.provenReport(t.ID, a.Started) on store root. So Rust helper: task_reports(root, task) + metadata (size, mtime) + select(times, started, skew). started from agent.started parsed via go_rfc3339. Skew: settings.values.report_clock_skew_seconds() — allowed only if matches Go producer (reportClockSkew constant). State missing evidence: whether Go's reportClockSkew equals the setting default 2s — assume yes, note uncertainty.

Attribution reasons: Go returns French reason strings; ReportAttribution::Unavailable{reason}. Ambiguous → "plusieurs rapports candidats..."; stale → "aucun rapport produit..."; missing → "aucun rapport lisible...". select() returns static codes, but Go returns specific messages including joining candidates. Note the difference: relay's select doesn't list ambiguous candidates; Go provenReport does. For strict parity we may need reason strings. Propose helper proven_report returning Result<Result<(String,String),String>,E> or map select codes to Go reason text.

Also incomplete-delivery branch requires planning.Repository — excluded, keep NotObserved refusal (it's only consumed when blocker prefix "Livraison incomplète :" which is managed/repo shape; for nonmanaged planned blocked, assume not that blocker — but blocker could be that text? incompleteDeliveryReport requires Planning.Repository != nil, so nonmanaged never yields report; Go returns "" → report state stays absent. Rust's branch is consumed when blocker prefix matches; would refuse incomplete-report-unobserved. Narrow fix: since Go returns "" without repo, supply IncompleteReport::Observed(None) when planning has no repository, or refuse? Minimal: root supplies Observed(None) in that case (Go-verified: returns "" when Planning==nil). Actually the Rust branch is entered regardless of repo; Go requires repo. If nonmanaged blocked task had that blocker prefix, Go shows delivery_incomplete with no report. So supplying Observed(None) reproduces Go.

Also changed-report/skip on stat error: Go provenReport continues on safeReport/stat errors (skips unreadable). relay's report errors out on metadata/hash failures. For display helper, Go skips unreadable candidates — so helper should skip per-file errors rather than refuse? That's a contract difference; note it. Actually Go skips (continue) — yes. So display helper must skip stat/containment failures per candidate, but taskReports() already refuses on IO. Hmm — taskReports in Rust refuses on errors; Go taskReports also? Unknown. Keep taskReports as is; for metadata/hash of candidates, Go provenReport skips errors. Relay errors. For display, follow Go: skip. But artifact_metadata errors could be containment... Go safeReport skip. Propose skip with note.

Also provenReport hashes? No — Go provenReport doesn't hash; relay hashes for submission. Display only needs path. So helper doesn't need artifact_hash. Good, lighter.

Also missing evidence: agent.started parse errors → Go returns reason "date de départ de la tentative illisible" as Unavailable. So parse failure → Unavailable with that reason, not Err.

Now structure answer ≤1800 words: (1) missing contracts & shape, (2) helper + call-site patches, (3) 5 tests, (4) gaps/assumptions.

Edits:

A. mission_status_reports.rs (or new helper in same file):
- planned_pair: blocked branch add `|| agent.status=="completed"`? Careful: that would also admit blocked+completed without review into supported(). Go does display it, so yes — but only nonmanaged planned. planned_pair is used in supported() planning branch. Minimal: change blocked arm to `matches!(...,"failed"|"interrupted") || agent.status=="completed"`. But matching_review still used elsewhere? matching_review also used in terminal loop and review_shape. Terminal loop: Some("completed") => matches submitted|accepted || (blocked && matching_review). Change to blocked allowed. review_shape: for non-passed review requires completed+matching — keep. But if no review at all, review_requires_projection false → fine.

- supported_view: blocked not in allowed statuses list ("todo|submitted|accepted|abandoned") — blocked with agent passes because agent exists. OK.

- result_inputs_with_review: guard `agent.status=="completed" && !matches!(submitted|accepted) && !(blocked && Presented)` → change to also allow blocked without review (fall through to completed branch like Go). New condition: refuse only if completed && !submitted && !accepted && task.status != "blocked". Then review for blocked without review: observe() returns NotApplicable (no independent_review). Fine.

- attribution: currently always NotObserved. For completed blocked path, compute via new helper proven_report(root, agent, skew) and set ReportAttribution. Only in the completed branch condition (agent completed, task blocked). Actually Go only consumes attribution in the completed fallthrough branch; supplying it for completed+blocked is enough. But careful: for blocked+Presented review it's not consumed — Go also computes it (provenReport called before? No — Go calls s.provenReport only inside the final completed branch after review branches return). To preserve "no fabrication", only observe when it will be consumed: agent completed && task.status=="blocked" && review NotApplicable. Simpler: compute when completed && blocked; harmless but observation policy says only consume. I'll gate on the actual branch: after review observation, if matches!(review, NotApplicable|NotObserved?) and completed && blocked. Implement in result_inputs_with_review after review computed.

- incomplete_report: when blocked && blocker prefix && no repository → IncompleteReport::Observed(None).

- Reports listing: keep NotObserved for completed (Go doesn't call taskReports in completed branch except via provenReport). Good.

Helper signature:

```rust
/// Go Store.provenReport over the mission root (read-only display).
pub(super) fn proven_report(root:&Path, agent:&Agent, skew:i64, causes?)->Result<Result<Option<String>,String>,E>
```
Simplify: returns Result<ReportAttribution-ish, E>: Ok(Ok(path)) | Ok(Err(reason)) | Err(E). Uses task_reports(root,&agent.task_id)?, parse started via swarm_wire_json::go_rfc3339 (already a dep per relay). Parse failure → Ok(Err("date de départ de la tentative illisible")). Reuse relay's select()? It's private in mission_report_relay; make it pub(super)/pub(crate) or move. Minimal: make `select` pub(crate) in mission_report_relay and call it. Note select skips size==0 silently while Go counts them as neither fresh nor stale — matches (Go continues on size==0 too, without stale++). Good.

Per-candidate: for each path from task_reports, artifact_metadata; on error → skip (Go continue). Metadata in relay maps errors to caused — for display we skip instead. size==0 skip. mtime < since → stale++. Ambiguity: select returns Err("mission-report-ambiguous") without candidate list; Go includes joined names. Propose: before calling select, or augment: for parity, count fresh in helper and produce Go reason strings directly rather than reusing select's static codes; note the drift. I'll implement counting in the helper mirroring Go, reusing select for the single/fresh decision, then map:
- ambiguous → format "plusieurs rapports candidats pour cette tentative ({joined})"
- stale → "aucun rapport produit par cette tentative ; {n} rapport(s) antérieur(s) ignoré(s)"
- missing → "aucun rapport lisible et non vide sous docs/ pour cette tâche"
But select doesn't return stale count or names; to keep minimal, replicate the loop in the helper (it's ~15 lines) instead of reusing select — cleaner parity. I'll propose a local loop, noting select is not reused to preserve exact Go reason text; no hidden clock margin: skew = settings.values.report_clock_skew_seconds() (matches Go reportClockSkew — verify constant; if Go hardcodes 2s and setting is that, ok; else pass Go constant). Note uncertainty.

Call site in result_inputs_with_review needs settings — currently not passed. observed_result_inputs has settings; it calls result_inputs_with_review without settings. Patch: pass skew (i64) or settings into result_inputs_with_review. Minimal: add parameter `skew: i64` computed in observed_result_inputs via settings.values.report_clock_skew_seconds().map_err(E::Settings)?. Update test-only result_inputs adapter with skew 0 or the same.

Attribution mapping: Ok(Some(path)) → Attributed(path) (nonempty guaranteed since size>0). Ok(Err(reason)) → Unavailable{reason}.

Also Unavailable reason used as: p.reason = format!("Le processus est terminé normalement, mais {reason}.") — Go matches.

Ordering note: task_reports sorts newest-first like Go s.taskReports? Go taskReports presumably newest first; ambiguity reason joins fresh in that order — matches.

Also report_id from earlier: report_id already set from submittedReport(t) at top; in completed branch Go overwrites with proven report. Rust does p.report_id = report.clone() — ok.

Safety: review precedence preserved (review branch before completed). Submitted/accepted unchanged. No cwd use (agent.workspace unused; relay excluded). No mutation.

Tests (5):
1. completed blocked, no review, one fresh nonempty report in docs → result_to_review, attributable_unsubmitted, report_id path, review count 1, validated 0.
2. missing reports (empty docs) → completed_unproven, reason "…mais aucun rapport lisible et non vide sous docs/ pour cette tâche.", report_state absent_or_unattributed.
3. stale: report mtime older than started−skew → completed_unproven with "…1 rapport(s) antérieur(s) ignoré(s)".
4. ambiguous: two fresh → Unavailable with "plusieurs rapports candidats…" listing both; also empty-size candidate ignored (not ambiguous).
5. unreadable/malformed started → Unavailable("date de départ de la tentative illisible"); and supported()/planning-unported no longer fires for blocked+completed (fixture upgrade): full supported()+project through public fixture path returns readable status.

Maybe also: relay still refuses (NotApplicable/Waiting) — mention.

- Go reportClockSkew constant value not supplied; must confirm equals saved setting's producer (2s default) before consuming report_timestamp_skew_seconds; else hardcode Go constant.
- Go taskReports ordering/behavior on unreadable docs unknown beyond supplied snippets; assumed newest-first.
- Go provenReport skips stat/safeReport errors per candidate — Rust task_reports refuses on walk IO; per-candidate metadata skip proposed; whether Go skips containment refusal vs errors is unverified.
